title: GitHub Actions CI/CD: From Pull Request to Production
concept: Build the pipeline a small team actually ships with: workflows and triggers, caching dependencies, test matrices, building and pushing images, environments with approvals, secrets and OIDC, and a deploy job that can roll back. Challenges are workflow files graded by a run simulator.
description: Build the pipeline a small team actually ships with: workflows and triggers, caching dependencies, test matrices, building and pushing images, environments with approvals, secrets and OIDC, and a deploy job that can roll back. Challenges are workflow files graded by a run simulator. 8 lessons, each applying the tool to a real production situation, with 1-2 graded challenges per lesson.

learningOutcomes.text: Trigger the right workflows for pull requests and pushes, with ordered jobs, a read-only token and time limits.
Keep CI fast and trustworthy with lockfile-keyed caches, test matrices, fail-fast choices and service containers.
Build and push traceable images and deploy them through environments with approvals and concurrency groups.
Lock a pipeline down: least-privilege tokens, OIDC instead of stored cloud keys, pinned actions and no script injection.
Gate a deploy on health checks, roll back on failure and share one pipeline across repositories with reusable workflows.

knownIssues: Challenges grade workflow files with a simulator of the documented GitHub Actions behaviour (triggers, expressions, matrices, caches, concurrency), not on real runners.
testedVersions are not yet re-checked against live runners.

lessons.title: Workflows, triggers and jobs for every pull request
